data.body: Ticket 1 (pudgy-jolly-guppy, ADR) CLOSED -- completion verification passed with ref pinned to the actual merged commit (9d5d062a40698d40be2e14879cc2ebe6f4d977ed) after the MCP server's default completion-verifier read a stale cached clone (only saw ADRs through 0104, missing my just-merged 0107/0108). Filed feedback on the MCP idle-timeout pattern separately; noting here too: the completion-verifier's default ref also appears to lag origin/main -- passing an explicit --ref/ref to the exact landed SHA is the reliable workaround. Gerrit change 2441 submitted+merged. Ticket 2 (uncheering-uncivil-pig, DET-tier priority backfill) is now unblocked. Proceeding: review-plan -> claim -> TDD held-out loop for ticket 2.
